name: Paid to hold: negative funding in an uptrend
status_note: Passed every LAB gate on out-of-sample data. PAPER TRADING ONLY (RULES.md): do not go live until the owner says 'go live'.

universe.rule: Each calendar month M (00:00 UTC on day 1): rank Binance USDT-M perpetuals by the sum of 1h quote volume over [M - 30 days, M). Keep the top 10.
universe.include_only: crypto underlyings (exclude TradFi stock/ETF/commodity, index and stablecoin perps)
universe.must_be_trading: the symbol's last bar with trades > 0 opened within the 24h before M
universe.membership_needed_for: new entries only (entry bar's month); open positions may run past month end
universe.renamed_contracts: separate symbols (e.g. MATICUSDT and POLUSDT are not stitched)

timeframe: 4h bars anchored at 00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC built from four complete 1h bars; act only on CLOSED bars

indicators.SMA_fast: simple mean of the last 50 4h closes (incl. bar t)
indicators.SMA_slow: simple mean of the last 200 4h closes (incl. bar t)
indicators.ATR14: simple mean of the last 14 true ranges, TR = max(high-low, |high-prev close|, |low-prev close|)
indicators.F8: latest SETTLED funding rate x 8 / funding_interval_hours of that settlement, as known at the bar close (a settlement is usable from the first bar whose close is after its calc time); no predicted funding

entry.condition: at 4h close t: close > SMA_fast > SMA_slow AND F8 < 0
entry.leg_rule: one signal per uptrend leg: after a signal, disarm until a 4h close < SMA_fast; a signal is consumed even if no order is placed
entry.order: market (taker) at the open of bar t+1
skip_if: symbol not in the universe for the entry bar's month
bar t or bar t+1 has trades == 0
a position in this symbol is already open
stop would already be at/above the entry price

stop.price: entry_fill_reference - 2.0 x ATR14 at bar t (entry reference = bar t+1 open)
stop.gap_rule: if a bar opens below the stop, exit at that open

exits: 4h close < SMA_fast -> market exit at the next 4h open
first funding settlement with F8 > 0.0001 (= 0.01% per 8h) seen at a 4h close -> market exit at the next 4h open
no profit target, no time stop
delisting announced/contract stops: close immediately (backtest: last real trade -2%, ESTIMATE)

sizing.if_below_min_notional: skip the trade (do not round up the risk)

cost_assumptions.funding: real settlements while held (long pays positive rate)

backtest.data: data.binance.vision archive (data/MANIFEST.csv); window 2022-11-01 .. 2026-10-31 23:59 UTC; delisted symbols included

monitoring.weakening: rolling 12-month expectancy < +0.05R after costs, or losing streak > 15, or drawdown > 28% (Monte Carlo 95th pct)
monitoring.kill: drawdown > 30% of peak equity, or rolling 100-trade expectancy < 0 after costs
